historical_commentary.text: This note demonstrates uploading pictures from a web browser and storing them directly in a 4D database, described as an approachable technique even for beginners. The general goal — accepting image uploads from a web client into 4D — remains a common requirement, but the specific 2001-era web-server upload mechanism has been superseded by modern 4D REST/ORDA endpoints and richer built-in support for handling multipart form uploads and BLOB/picture fields.
related_updates: 4D's REST/ORDA APIs now provide more modern mechanisms for handling file/image uploads from web and mobile clients
4D's built-in Web Server has gained more native multipart/form-upload handling since 2001
